The '''Sea of Flames''' was a small [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] that separated the continents of [[Keshtah Minor]] and [[Alanciar]] on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[2975 BBY]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] planned an [[Mission to Alanciar|expeditionary mission]] to [[Alanciar]] which involved returning to Keshtah by flying over the Sea of Flames. After the mission was attacked by [[Alanciari]] forces, the survivors of [[Edell Vrai]]'s ill-fated mission traveled back to Alanciar through the Sea of Flames. They used a hijacked Alanciari trawler ''[[Mischance]]'' and brought with the Alanciari signals officer [[Jogan Halder]].
